question_text:
Consider the following statements made about the standing wave on a stretched string. 
(A) The energy does not propagate along a standing wave.
(B) The amplitude of the stationary wave particle in the string depends on its position along the string.
(C) Maximum displacement achieved varies with time.

options.option_text: Only A and B are true.
Only B and C are true.
A, B and C are true.
